title: A PRAYER FOR
YOUR HOUSEHOLD
end: The Family Altar — cover your home in prayer
stock_queries: warm lamp light on open bible
golden hour light on dining table

scenes.a: If you are currently feeling overwhelmed by the financial weight of your family’s future, stay.
Praise the Lord. Blessed are those who fear the Lord, who find great delight in his commands.
Their children will be mighty in the land; the generation of the upright will be blessed.
Wealth and riches are in their houses, and their righteousness endures forever.
Heavenly Father, we bring our home before You, asking that our hearts remain anchored in Your Word.
Grant us the wisdom to walk in Your ways, that our legacy might reflect Your goodness always.
